Sora2.prompt: Low angle shot starting from the base of an old wooden wheelchair, slowly tilting upward to reveal a pale young Chinese man with a cold, menacing expression sitting in the wheelchair. He has sharp angular face, narrow phoenix eyes with dark intense brooding gaze, thin pale lips with cold sneer, long disheveled black hair, wearing dark worn black traditional robe. Silhouette against cold blue-grey lighting with warm candlelight accent, gradually revealing his features as the camera moves up. Ancient Chinese room setting, dilapidated walls, mysterious menacing atmosphere. Fallen noble aura, yandere aesthetic. The shot ends with a medium close-up of his face, emphasizing his oppressive presence.

SeeDance.prompt: 仰角拍摄，从破旧木制轮椅底部缓缓上移，逐渐展现沈清起的身影。他是一位22岁的苍白病态青年，面容棱角分明，狭长凤眼目光阴鸷，苍白薄唇带着冷笑，黑色长发略显凌乱，身穿破旧的玄色交领长袍。青灰色冷光剪影效果，随着镜头上移，他苍白的面容逐渐从阴影中显现，病娇气质的落魄贵族。背景是破旧的古代房屋，斑驳的墙壁，深邃的黑暗空间。压迫感十足的反派首次亮相，神秘的阴冷氛围。镜头结束于他的中近景面部特写，强调压迫感和权威感。
